mathematical_audit.generator_transport: Substitution of the Item406 Hermite identities gives lambda0=-(epsilon0+epsilon1) and A lambda1=-(5n-7)epsilon0-(5n-1)epsilon1. The coefficient determinant is 6, so the generator pairs have identical local Smith invariants away from 6A.
mathematical_audit.primitive_carrier: For epsilon0=s-Zu and epsilon1=r-Z(u+v), the connection and cubic forms are D=ur-s(u+v), V0=s^3-Ku^3, and V1=r^3-K(u+v)^3 up to units/signs. The common coefficient ideal equals (u,v,r,s), giving the exact primitive exponent formula.
mathematical_audit.marked_unmarked: The original residues evaluate the generators at X_p=2^E, so collision means the distinguished equations s=X_p u and r=X_p(u+v). Vanishing of the Smith forms only forces a common y with y^3=K. Thus y=zeta X_p; the conditions coincide for q=5 mod 6 but the unmarked carrier has two extra branches for q=1 mod 6.
mathematical_audit.positive_exponent_form: Frobenius below degree p replaces the negative powers by exponent E=p-(4m+1). Combining the Item406 boundary formulas with X_p 2^(-n)=4^m yields exactly the two displayed F/J equations.
mathematical_audit.transform_no_go: For an arbitrary normalized truncated R, the two marked boundary functionals have a 2x2 minor Y^2 k^2(k^2-1)/6 on r_(n-2),r_(n-3), nonzero for every compatible parameter. This proves only that triangularity and normalization are insufficient; it is not an actual-family counterexample.
mathematical_audit.capacity: The selected noncollision theorem would close the separate strictly-large-prime component, but no such theorem or valuation-weighted density estimate is proved. Radical sparsity alone would not control high p-adic depth.
